abilities.name: Center of Gravity
abilities.condition: Flow requirement removed August 29; B and on-ball were listed August 22

history.title: Rin improvements
history.text: Added missing base sound effects and removed the flow requirement from Center of Gravity. Awakening effects and You'll Never Surpass Me revised.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Rin awakening fixes
history.text: Center of Gravity became available with awakening and flow active at the time; Two Steps Behind added a shot cutscene for the receiver. The flow requirement was later removed.

history.title: U20 Rin rework
history.text: New base moves and awakening changes with revised VFX and animations; some awakening features were still pending.

history.title: Dragon Drive and overtime awakening
history.text: Added aerial C-key Dragon Drive to NEL Shidou and custom awakening bars. Overtime grants awakening to one random player on each team.

history.title: July quality of life
history.text: New awakening bars, titles and Bachira MVP.

history.title: NEL Rin and Hiori balance
history.text: Rin Annihilate speed and power +5%; Hiori Cold Logic Turn became a full dribble, Link Pass range 95m and Below Zero Pass range +20% to 130m.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Mini update and private server settings
history.text: Old moves and sound effects returned; infinite stamina and infinite flow settings were added to PS+, alongside an option to hide other players' cosmetics.

history.title: Master Of All Trades changes
history.text: Master Of All Trades became World Class and received a revised set of bonuses; Reo gained two awakening cutscenes.

history.title: Original map and quality of life
history.text: Original map revamped; Sae secret awakening and MVP previews added. Yukimiya restored to Mythic and Gyro Shot returned to B.

history.title: Mobile controls and fixes
history.text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

history.title: Rin return
history.text: Rin returned in an earlier update, before the August U20 rework.

history.title: Rivals chemical reaction and Demon King
history.text: Rivals chemistry at defending kickoff when both centre forwards use NEL Isagi and NEL Rin; World Class Demon King flow introduced.

history.title: Prodigies versus Talented Learners
history.text: NEL Rin and NEL Isagi were reworked for the event.

history.title: NEL Nagi and Singularity
history.text: NEL Nagi World Class at release, with volley and ball-control passives. Singularity flow introduced and other styles adjusted.

history.title: NEL Rin and flow rework
history.text: NEL Rin changed from Mythic to World Class at that date, with style and flow rework.
